description: IdeaVault agent evaluation cases. Each case seeds a fresh vault (setup), sends a chat message to the Agent Supervisor and checks the requested tool sequence (tool_prefix: exact prefix offline, in-order subsequence for real models), the permission categories of executed tools, forbidden tools, answer text and the resulting vault state. Run offline with `go test ./internal/integration -run TestAgentEvaluationCases` (TEST_DATABASE_URL required) or against a real model with `EVAL_MODEL=provider/model go run ./cmd/eval`.
